response.sql:
WITH per_site_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.zoneref,
        si.entrystat,
        AVG(sp.memusagegb) as avg_ram_per_site,
        AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / CAST(sp.proccpu AS REAL)) as avg_gpu_cpu_per_site
    FROM scanprocessing sp
    JOIN sites si ON sp.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
    WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8
        AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL
        AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL
        AND sp.proccpu <> 0
    GROUP BY sp.zoneref, si.entrystat
)
SELECT 
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_ram_per_site) as avg_ram,
    AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_per_site) as avg_gpu_cpu
FROM per_site_stats
GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: "Memory-heavy processing runs" are defined as those with memusagegb ≥ 60.8, as explicitly stated in the request.
"Site code matches a site" means the zoneref exists in the sites table, enforced via INNER JOIN to sites.zoneregistry.
Records where proccpu is NULL or 0 are excluded from ratio calculations to avoid division by zero; NULL values are otherwise ignored per SQL AVG semantics.

alternatives.interpretation: GPU-to-CPU ratio computed as ratio of per-site averages (AVG(procgpu) ÷ AVG(proccpu)), rather than average of individual record ratios (AVG(procgpu ÷ proccpu)).

    FROM scanprocessing sp

    WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8
        AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL
        AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL
        AND sp.proccpu <> 0
    GROUP BY sp.zoneref, si.entrystat
)
SELECT 
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_ram_per_site) as avg_ram,
    AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_per_site) as avg_gpu_cpu
FROM per_site_stats
GROUP BY entrystat
